neighbours.label: The preposition right after a noun that weighs up or compares ('the lovely thing about', 'the major downside to', 'one of the benefits of', 'autre avantage de', 'one difference between'); these prepositions after other words stay quiet.
fire: The best part about this job is the view.
That's the main drawback to living here.
One of the perks of teaching is summer.
Le grand avantage de cette méthode est simple.
The key difference between them is cost.
My favorite part of her talk was the end.
The worst thing about winter is the dark.
A big advantage of solar is its price.
quiet: The old book about this town is out of print.
That's the main road to the coast.
One of the sons of Mary is here.
Le grand frère de cette fille est simple.
The long bridge between them is closed.
My old copy of her talk was torn.
The thing on the shelf is dusty.
A big box of apples is on the porch.

notes: Probes: 0.59-0.89; other uses 0.01-0.05. ' about' is the peak in 17 of the top 32. One near miss keeps ' thing' with a neutral use, and one has ' about' after a noun that isn't evaluative.
